mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals labor market weakness, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals robust economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) show a simultaneous decline over two consecutive months, it signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and PAYEMS both decline for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and PAYEMS decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as stable prices support consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and simultaneously the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a regime of economic stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE is above 6% and FEDFUNDS is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate robust corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters.
